rationale: Both describe the scene well: giraffes on reddish packed dirt beside a rustic wooden shelter, a stone retaining wall, trees and forested mountains behind, and a log and branch pile at the far left. A is more accurate on key details. It correctly says the young giraffe's head and neck poke up into view at the bottom center, whereas B wrongly says the calf's head is lowered near the ground. B also says the prominent central adult is facing away from the camera, but that giraffe faces toward the viewer with its neck raised. A's account of the necks (one raised toward the roof, one stretched horizontally to the right, two more in the shade on the left) matches the image. B's 'terracotta-style' tiles slightly misstate the greyish curved tiles. A is more precise.
